summary: This joint resolution authorizes the President to use U.S. Armed Forces against Iran to dismantle its nuclear program, address threats to U.S. forces, enforce a blockade of Iranian ports, and ensure safe passage through the Strait of Hormuz, while prohibiting sustained ground combat or occupation within Iran, and requires regular reports to Congress, with the authority expiring on July 30, 2026.
